newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dillon Read cuts airline stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dillon Read cuts airline stocks.

text.p: Dillon Read & Co Inc said it downgraded recommendations on several airline stocks.
-- said believes industry's earnings momentum is now negative and that the 1998 consensus estimates are too high.
-- said load factors and fares are at very high levels and said "we do not see that they can be push much further."
-- said industry's tax level may be pushed higher under tax proposals being mulled in Congress.
-- said unit costs "are now entering an upward spiral."
-- said labor and other non-fuel cash costs are rising after cost-cutting seen in the middle 1990s.
-- said "only broght spot on the expense side is an expected moderate jet fuel price for the foreseeable future."
-- said cut AMR Corp, America West Holdings Corp and Alaska Air Group Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- said cut Continental Airlines Inc to neutral from buy.
-- said cut Delta Air Lines Inc, Midwest Express Holdings Inc and Reno Air Inc to outperform from buy.
-- said cut Southwest Airlines Co to neutral from outperform.
-- said cut UAL Corp to neutral from buy.
-- said cut US Airways Group Inc to outperform from buy.
